rows.altar-lifts-devotion-to-five-before-type: CR 700.5a: the Altar's devotion increase counts when Purphoros's type-changing effect is evaluated, so devotion 4 plus 1 makes Purphoros a creature. Observed: Purphoros stayed a Legendary Enchantment God, not a creature (two Mogg Fanatics in place of the Altar, devotion 5 by permanents, do make it a creature).
